fact_rationales.F13: Flat rod electroretinogram is more typical of progressive retinal degenerations like Retinitis Pigmentosa, rather than stationary conditions like Congenital Stationary Night Blindness.
fact_rationales.F15: Superotemporal zones showing hypofluorescence on Fundus Autofluorescence can be seen in several conditions, but in this context, it supports progressive retinal degenerations.
fact_rationales.F23: Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in the superotemporal region is more characteristic of progressive conditions like Retinitis Pigmentosa or Choroideremia, rather than stationary conditions.

ranked_facts.why: Superotemporal zones showing hypofluorescence is consistent with Enhanced S-cone syndrome
